coverage.evidence: Economy sidebar entry at dashboard/src/layouts/dashboard/navigation.ts:252-255 and Currency tab at dashboard/src/views/dashboard/economy/EconomyView.vue:42-46. Currency on, Currency name and Save currency come from CurrencyPanel.vue:115-120 and 191-199 with i18n/en.json:28-38. Server defaults (points/points/off/0/no limit/0) are in server/src/NomNomzBot.Domain/Economy/Entities/CurrencyConfigDefaults.cs:20-29, and the server validates name, starting balance and decimal places 0-8 at CurrencyConfigService.cs:55-74. Moderator-default access is at ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:446-451 and 464-465 (Mod=10, above it Lead 20, Editor 30, Broadcaster 40 at lines 51-54). Turning on an existing rule takes effect on the next event because CurrencyEarningService.cs:48-57 reads the enabled rule fresh for each event.

Rules are seeded disabled with rates 1/10/100/200/200/1/500/250 at EarningRuleSeedOnOnboardingHandler.cs:43-56 and 95. A new rule is saved switched on at RuleDialog.vue:91. Deleting a rule only sets DeletedAt at CurrencyConfigService.cs:184, and an edit only changes the rule row at lines 147-155, so no balance is touched. Raid units are ViewerCount at EngagementEarningHandler.cs:110 and cheer units are Bits at line 91, multiplied by the rate at CurrencyEarningService.cs:84. Watch time has no caller (ApplyWatchTimeBatchAsync is referenced only in ICurrencyEarningService.cs:32), and no handler earns for the GiftSubscription source. A gift recipient earns through channel.subscribe with is_gift (SubscriptionTranslators.cs:37-45), while a resub is a separate ResubscriptionEvent (lines 57-60) with no earning handler (EngagementEarningHandler.cs:33-36). Muted or shadowbanned chatters are skipped at ChatEarningHandler.cs:45-51. Redeliveries are deduplicated by message id at NotificationDispatcher.cs:93 and CurrencyEarningService.cs:71-82. A payout over the cap is refused whole, not clamped (CurrencyAccountService.cs:403 and 425, CurrencyEarningService.cs:153-154). Seconds per payout limits nothing without PerWindowCap (CurrencyEarningService.cs:89).

An adjustment posts a signed AdminAdjust entry (CurrencyAccountService.cs:310-329). It is refused when the currency is disabled (lines 133-137), when the wallet is frozen (393-394), when it would overdraw (402, 420-424) or when it would pass Highest balance (403, 425-429). AdjustDialog.vue:46-55 requires a nonzero whole amount and a reason and shows i18n/en.json:84. The list asks for Take 100 (dashboard/src/api/economy.ts:499 and 518), MaxPageSize is 100 (PaginationParams.cs:28), and rows are ordered by balance, highest first (CurrencyAccountService.cs:93). The earned total sums every positive ledger entry, adjustments included (CurrencyBalanceProjection.cs:94-100). The freeze switch has an aria-label from i18n/en.json:74 (BalancesPanel.vue:106-111).

A jar is created with Balance 0 and IsOpen true (SavingsJarService.cs:51-61, JarDialog.vue:71). Contribute refuses a closed jar (SavingsJarService.cs:350-351). The jar_contribute step debits ctx.TriggeredByUserId (JarContributeAction.cs:54 and 63-66). Closing only flips IsOpen (SavingsJarService.cs:135-136). Delete is a soft delete with no refund (lines 144-156). Owner-only update and delete are at lines 108-109, and owner-only invite at 229-233. A duplicate invite is refused at 239-251. Only the invited channel may accept (289-293), and use requires an accepted membership (337-346, 715-726). Role is never checked on contribute or withdraw. The caps are enforced at 352-374 and 484-490. The Partner default is at InviteDialog.vue:41. The deposits card is at SavingsJars.vue:143-148 with i18n/en.json:101-102.

reader_answers.evidence: Each step matches a real control: Currency on, Currency name and Save currency (CurrencyPanel.vue:115-199). Edit rule, Amount earned, Save rule and the row switch are at EarningRules.vue:134-147 and RuleDialog.vue:139-147. Adjust the balance, Amount, Reason and Adjust balance are at BalancesPanel.vue:98-105 and AdjustDialog.vue:86-115. The labels come from i18n/en.json.

Moderator is the default for config, earning rules, accounts, adjust and freeze, and higher rungs pass too (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:446-451 and 464-465). An adjustment needs an enabled currency (CurrencyAccountService.cs:133-137). The list is the top 100 by balance (economy.ts:499, CurrencyAccountService.cs:93).

The dialog closes on success (AdjustDialog.vue:71) and the accounts query is invalidated (economy.ts:537-539). The Off badge shows only while a rule is disabled (EarningRules.vue:133). A rule upsert is per source for the whole channel (CurrencyConfigService.cs:137-155), while an adjustment is a per-wallet ledger entry (CurrencyAccountService.cs:310-329).

An AdminAdjust entry changes only that viewer's wallet by the signed amount and records the Reason (CurrencyAccountService.cs:310-329 and 491). It does not touch the rule (CurrencyConfigService.cs:137-155). The refusals for below 0, above the max and frozen are at CurrencyAccountService.cs:393-429.
